title: Overtime Earnings and Timecard Corrections — Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan Bank Transfer Terms
content:
**Paystride Earned Wage Access Plan.** For the bank accrued net of a next-business-day transfer to the worker's bank account, overtime lines count in the part the overtime share provides.

Where the tier counts overtime, overtime lines count toward the bank accrued net at the overtime share: not at all when two or more earnings correction lines with a work date in the last two months stand on the plan, one half when exactly one does, and in full otherwise; where the tier does not count overtime they do not count.

A record falls in the last N months when fewer than N whole months separate its date from today, whole months being the difference in calendar months less one when today's day of the month is smaller than that date's.

| Earnings correction lines on the plan with a work date in the last two months | Overtime share |
|---|---|
| none | in full |
| exactly 1 | one half |
| 2 or more | not at all |

*Hypothetical:* current-period overtime lines of 77.50 USD count in full with no correction in the last two months, as 38.75 USD with one, and not at all with two.
